name: Loops activation 2
request: Write exactly one English activation email from the Loops team. Reader: A developer with a Loops account and a draft transactional template. Ask them to do one thing: Run a first transactional email test to their own address. Use a specific, documented first step and explain why it helps this reader. Keep the email under 150 words excluding subject, preview and signature. Avoid unsupported access, plan, timing and outcome claims. Use one CTA with an exact documented destination if available.
target_market: A developer with a Loops account and a draft transactional template.

intent.desired_action: Run a first transactional email test to their own address
